meta.name: chess_carvers
meta.prompt: A village of stone-carvers laid out on a colossal chessboard of black and white marble squares, with giant chess pieces as its monuments: a king-piece tower at the centre and two knight-pieces guarding the road in.

programs.brief: A colossal king chess piece monument carved from polished white quartz and polished blackstone with an enterable interior chamber and cross finial.
A monumental rearing horse-head knight chess piece carved from polished contrasting black and white stone blocks on a heavy stepped plinth.

tokens.terrain: a flat basin paved as a colossal checkered chessboard of alternating black and white marble tiles
tokens.icons: a monumental king-piece tower rising at the board center; two colossal rearing knight-piece statues flanking the approach road; stone-carver workshops, sculptors' scaffolds, and dressing yards set upon the squares
